modmenu.descriptionTranslation.comparato:
Inspect the current comparator signal (0–15) of chests and other readable blocks.

Point at a block or show nearby signals within a configurable radius. Independently customize general block labels, comparator output labels and the info panel. Each has its own visibility, colors, opacity and text size. General block and comparator labels also have separate height settings. Comparator labels support negative offsets. Each display can show just the output value without / 15. Enable comparator outputs separately to show actual circuit outputs, including compare/subtract mode and side inputs.

Start with /ci or the configuration button. Nearby radius: 1–32 blocks. Label height: 0.00–3.00 blocks for general blocks, -3.00–3.00 for comparators.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Requires Fabric API. Multiplayer needs the mod on both server and client. Reads real server values in loaded chunks only.
